<config>
  <definition>
    <element name="preview" width="149px" edit="false">
      <display class="ThumbWdg">
        <detail>false</detail>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="assets_category_code" edit="true"/>
    <element name="assets_category" width="80" edit="true">
      <display widget="expression">
        <expression>@GET(cg/assets_category.name)</expression>
        <calc_mode>fast</calc_mode>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="texture_in_assets" width="108px" edit="false">
      <display widget="hidden_row">
        <search_type>cg/texture</search_type>
        <expression>@SOBJECT(cg/texture_in_assets.cg/texture)</expression>
        <dynamic_class>tactic.ui.panel.FastTableLayoutWdg</dynamic_class>
        <show_shelf>true</show_shelf>
        <view>table</view>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="assets_in_assets" width="183px" edit="false">
      <display widget="hidden_row">
        <search_type>cg/assets</search_type>
        <expression>@SOBJECT(cg/assets['code', 'ASSETS00577'].parent:cg/assets_in_assets.child:cg/assets)</expression>
        <dynamic_class>tactic.ui.panel.FastTableLayoutWdg</dynamic_class>
        <show_shelf>true</show_shelf>
        <view>table</view>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="assets_in_scenes" width="108px" edit="false">
      <display widget="hidden_row">
        <search_type>cg/scenes</search_type>
        <expression>@SOBJECT(cg/assets_in_scenes.cg/scenes)</expression>
        <dynamic_class>tactic.ui.panel.FastTableLayoutWdg</dynamic_class>
        <show_shelf>true</show_shelf>
        <view>table</view>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="code"/>
    <element name="name" width="150" edit="true">
      <display class="tactic.ui.common.SimpleTableElementWdg"/>
    </element>
    <element name="description" width="250" edit="true">
      <display class="tactic.ui.common.SimpleTableElementWdg"/>
    </element>
    <element name="notes" width="82px" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.widget.DiscussionElementWdg">
        <use_parent>false</use_parent>
        <show_fullscreen_button>true</show_fullscreen_button>
        <note_format>full</note_format>
        <show_note_status>true</show_note_status>
        <show_context_notes>false</show_context_notes>
        <note_expandable>false</note_expandable>
        <allow_email>true</allow_email>
        <show_task_process>true</show_task_process>
        <mode>default</mode>
        <dialog_position>side</dialog_position>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="task_pipeline_panels" title="Task Workflow" width="420px" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.TaskElementWdg">
        <show_labels>false</show_labels>
        <task_filter>process_only</task_filter>
        <show_filler_tasks>true</show_filler_tasks>
        <show_assigned>true</show_assigned>
        <layout>panel</layout>
        <show_add_task>false</show_add_task>
        <show_current_pipeline_only>true</show_current_pipeline_only>
        <edit_status>true</edit_status>
        <show_processes_in_title>false</show_processes_in_title>
        <edit_assigned>true</edit_assigned>
        <bg_color>status</bg_color>
        <show_task_edit>false</show_task_edit>
        <show_border>none</show_border>
        <panel_width>75px</panel_width>
        <show_bid>false</show_bid>
        <font_size>12</font_size>
        <show_status>true</show_status>
        <show_process>true</show_process>
        <collate_columns>false</collate_columns>
        <status_color>status</status_color>
        <show_dates>false</show_dates>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="texture_drop" title="Texture Drop" width="130px" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.DropElementWdg">
        <instance_type>cg/texture_in_assets</instance_type>
        <accepted_drop_type>cg/texture</accepted_drop_type>
        <display_expr>@GET(cg/texture.name)</display_expr>
        <css_background-color>#425952</css_background-color>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="relative_dir">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.FormatElementWdg">
        <type/>
        <fps/>
        <format>None</format>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="keywords" width="150" edit="true">
      <display class="tactic.ui.common.SimpleTableElementWdg"/>
    </element>
    <element name="keyword" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.filter.KeywordFilterElementWdg">
        <column>name|keywords|description</column>
        <mode>keyword</mode>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="task_pipeline_vertical" title="Task Workflow">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.TaskElementWdg">
        <layout>vertical</layout>
        <status_color>status</status_color>
        <show_assigned>true</show_assigned>
        <show_dates>true</show_dates>
        <edit>true</edit>
        <edit_status>true</edit_status>
        <edit_assigned>true</edit_assigned>
        <show_filler_tasks>true</show_filler_tasks>
      </display>
      <action class="tactic.ui.table.TaskElementCbk"/>
    </element>
    <element name="delete" title=" " width="30px" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.RelatedElementWdg"/>
    </element>
    <element name="task_status_edit" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.TaskElementWdg">
        <show_labels>false</show_labels>
        <task_filter>process_only</task_filter>
        <show_filler_tasks>true</show_filler_tasks>
        <show_assigned>true</show_assigned>
        <layout>panel</layout>
        <show_add_task>false</show_add_task>
        <show_current_pipeline_only>true</show_current_pipeline_only>
        <edit_status>true</edit_status>
        <show_processes_in_title>false</show_processes_in_title>
        <edit_assigned>true</edit_assigned>
        <bg_color>status</bg_color>
        <show_task_edit>false</show_task_edit>
        <show_border>none</show_border>
        <panel_width>75px</panel_width>
        <show_bid>false</show_bid>
        <font_size>12</font_size>
        <show_status>true</show_status>
        <show_process>true</show_process>
        <collate_columns>false</collate_columns>
        <status_color>status</status_color>
        <show_dates>false</show_dates>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="task_edit" title="Tasks" width="55px" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.HiddenRowElementWdg">
        <show_gear>true</show_gear>
        <show_search_limit>true</show_search_limit>
        <search_type>sthpw/task</search_type>
        <show_insert>true</show_insert>
        <dynamic_class>tactic.ui.panel.FastTableLayoutWdg</dynamic_class>
        <show_search>false</show_search>
        <view>inline_add_item</view>
        <show_shelf>true</show_shelf>
        <init_load_num>50</init_load_num>
        <icon>FAS_TASKS</icon>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="notes_sheet" edit="false">
      <display class="tactic.ui.table.HiddenRowElementWdg">
        <dynamic_class>tactic.ui.app.NoteSheetWdg</dynamic_class>
        <use_parent>false</use_parent>
        <title_icon>note_go</title_icon>
      </display>
    </element>
    <element name="task" width="352px" edit="false">
      <display class="pyasm.widget.SObjectTaskTableElement">
        <width>250</width>
        <bid_edit>true</bid_edit>
        <simple_date>false</simple_date>
        <supe>true</supe>
      </display>
    </element>
  </definition>
  <simple_filter>
    <element name="keyword" title="">
      <display class="tactic.ui.filter.KeywordFilterElementWdg">
        <mode>keyword</mode>
        <column>process|note</column>
      </display>
    </element>
  </simple_filter>
</config>

<config><continuous_example layout="sobject-layout" collection="tree" flow="contents">
    <element name="preview" title="Preview" tag="span" role="preview"><display class="image"><bind>node.preview.image</bind></display></element>
    <element name="copy" title="Object information" role="copy" flow="contents"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="heading" title="Heading" parent="copy" role="title-line" flow="contents"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="title" title="Title" parent="heading" tag="strong"><display class="title"><bind>node.title</bind></display></element>
    <element name="quick" title="Snapshot actions" parent="heading" tag="span" role="title-actions" when="tree not-branch"><display class="quick-actions" /></element>
    <element name="offline" title="File Offline" parent="heading" tag="span" role="file-offline" when="tree snapshot"><display class="file-offline" /></element>
    <element name="description" title="Description" parent="copy" tag="span" role="description" when="description"><display class="description"><bind>node.subtitle</bind></display></element>
    <element name="metadata" title="Metadata" parent="copy" role="metadata" when="object"><display class="metadata" /></element>
    <element name="snapshot" title="Snapshot details" parent="copy" when="tree snapshot"><display class="snapshot-details" /></element>
    <element name="snapshot_summary" title="Snapshot summary" parent="copy" tag="small" tone="muted" when="not-tree snapshot"><display class="snapshot-summary" /></element>
    <element name="summary" title="Branch summary" parent="copy" tag="small" when="mobile branch"><display class="branch-summary" /></element>
    <element name="actions" title="Actions" role="actions" flow="contents"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="hover" title="Related objects" parent="actions" role="hover-actions" flow="contents" when="desktop tree object"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="relations" title="Related and child objects" parent="hover"><display class="button"><action>relations</action><icon>FAS_SITEMAP</icon></display></element>
    <element name="relation_actions" title="Relationship actions" parent="actions" when="desktop relation"><display class="relations" /></element>
    <element name="knowledge" title="Knowledge Base" parent="actions" when="desktop"><display class="knowledge" /></element>
    <element name="communication" title="Tasks and notes" parent="actions" role="communication" flow="contents" when="desktop object-or-process"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="tasks" title="Tasks" parent="communication" role="task-button"><display class="button"><action>tasks</action><icon>FAR_CALENDAR_CHECK</icon><badge>node.task_count</badge></display></element>
    <element name="notes" title="Notes" parent="communication" role="note-button"><display class="button"><action>notes</action><icon>FAS_COMMENT_ALT</icon><badge>node.note_count</badge></display></element>
    <element name="size" title="File size" parent="actions" tag="span" when="tree snapshot"><display class="snapshot-size" /></element>
    <element name="mobile_actions" title="Mobile actions" parent="actions" role="mobile-actions" flow="contents" when="mobile mobile-upload"><display class="group" /></element>
    <element name="mobile_tasks" title="Tasks" parent="mobile_actions" when="object-or-process"><display class="button"><action>tasks</action><icon>FAR_CALENDAR_CHECK</icon><badge>node.task_count</badge></display></element>
    <element name="mobile_notes" title="Notes" parent="mobile_actions" when="object-or-process"><display class="button"><action>notes</action><icon>FAS_COMMENT_ALT</icon><badge>node.note_count</badge></display></element>
    <element name="mobile_upload" title="Add files" parent="mobile_actions"><display class="button"><action>upload</action><icon>upload</icon></display></element>
    <element name="menu" title="Item actions" parent="actions" when="mobile"><display class="item-menu" /></element>
  </continuous_example>
  </config>

layout_templates.name: cards
layout_templates.xml:
<config><cards_example layout="sobject-layout" collection="grid" columns="12" card_width="280">
    <element name="image" title="Preview" row="1" height="160"><display class="image"><bind>node.preview.image</bind></display></element>
    <element name="title" title="Title" row="2"><display class="title"><bind>node.title</bind></display></element>
    <element name="description" title="Description" row="3"><display class="description"><bind>record.description</bind></display></element>
    <element name="details" title="Object details" row="4" span="6"><display class="button"><action>inspect</action><text>Object details</text><icon>MDI_INFORMATION_OUTLINE</icon></display></element>
    <element name="notes" title="Notes" row="4" column="7" span="6"><display class="button"><text>Notes</text><action>notes</action><badge>node.note_count</badge><icon>FAS_COMMENT_ALT</icon></display></element>
  </cards_example>
</config>

layout_templates.name: table
layout_templates.xml:
<config><table_example layout="sobject-layout" collection="table" columns="12">
    <element name="preview" title="Preview" column="1" span="2" height="40"><display class="image"><bind>node.preview.image</bind></display></element>
    <element name="title" title="Title" column="3" span="3"><display class="title"><bind>node.title</bind></display></element>
    <element name="description" title="Description" column="6" span="4"><display class="text"><bind>record.description</bind></display></element>
    <element name="tasks" title="Tasks" column="10" span="1"><display class="button"><action>tasks</action><badge>node.task_count</badge><icon>FAR_CALENDAR_CHECK</icon></display></element>
    <element name="notes" title="Notes" column="11" span="1"><display class="button"><action>notes</action><badge>node.note_count</badge><icon>FAS_COMMENT_ALT</icon></display></element>
    <element name="details" title="Object details" column="12" span="1"><display class="button"><action>inspect</action><icon>MDI_INFORMATION_OUTLINE</icon></display></element>
  </table_example>
  </config>
